verdict.rationale: Algolia's docs explicitly describe built-in Search Analytics covering popular searches, no-results queries, and click-through rates, plus comparison mode and CSV/XLSX export, and community feedback corroborates that Algolia analytics let users tie queries to business outcomes without heavy engineering. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the analytics dashboard UI itself (only docs + indirect community praise, no screenshots or detailed review of the analytics feature specifically).
